query: Which diagnostic thresholds (VIF cutoff, outer weight significance, HTMT, item loading) should we predefine to drop/retain overlapping items in PLS?

response.query: Which diagnostic thresholds (VIF cutoff, outer weight significance, HTMT, item loading) should we predefine to drop/retain overlapping items in PLS?
response.answer: For PLS, retain items with VIF < 5, outer weights > 0.7, HTMT < 0.85, and item loadings > 0.7.
